# Rikucherry's blog

> Rikucherry's blog: a Tokyo-based mobile developer's notes on Android, iOS, Flutter and Kotlin, book notes, and the indie-dev journey of the Snap Closet app.

- Site: https://rikucherry1993.me/
- Language: en
- Author: rikucherry
- License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
- Sitemap: https://rikucherry1993.me/sitemap.xml
- 中文 edition: https://rikucherry1993.me/llms.txt
- 日本語 edition: https://rikucherry1993.me/ja/llms.txt

## Posts

- [Snap Closet Is Fully Launched, and I Finally Entered Shipaton](https://rikucherry1993.me/en/posts/2026-09-04snap-closet-shipaton/) (2026-09-04): Snap Closet is now live on the App Store and Google Play. An overview of its closet and outfit features, the LLM-driven development process, and what entering Shipaton was like.
- [Snap Closet Android Beta Is Now Open](https://rikucherry1993.me/en/posts/2026-08-09snap-closet-android-beta/) (2026-08-09): How the Snap Closet Android beta was opened and how testers could sign up, with an overview of the app's core features. Beta recruitment closed on 2026-08-20.
